newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hospital Care in A$25 mln of deals.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hospital Care in A$25 mln of deals.

text.p: Hospital operator Australian Hospital Care Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to buy the Masada Private Hospital in Melbourne for A$10.25 million and had approved a A$15 million redevelopment of its The Avenue hospital in Melbourne.

"The impact of this announcement on company performance will be firstly, earnings per share positive with the purchase of Masada and secondly, the development of a first class, two campus facility into the new millenium," Australian Hospital Care said.
"Australian Hospital Care Ltd will finance the purchase of Masada and the development of The Avenue from its existing cash and banking facilities," it said.
The recently floated Australian Hospital Care is Australia's third largest private hospital group with about 1,200 beds.
Australian Hospital Care's shares were unchanged at A$2.39 at 12.20 p.m. (0120 GMT).
